confirmed_task:
Open the Hugging Face SQuAD dataset page, use the Dataset Viewer, and report the number of rows in the train split and validation split. Record the split names and row counts exactly as shown by the viewer.

Stopping condition: Stop after both Dataset Viewer split counts have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not edit or upload dataset files.

items.criterion: Navigate to the Hugging Face SQuAD dataset page
items.description: Navigate to the Hugging Face dataset page for SQuAD (context URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkar/squad). Full credit if the agent reaches the correct dataset page or clearly reports an uncontrollable blocker (site outage, network error, geo/IP block) after reasonable attempts.

items.criterion: Access and use the Dataset Viewer to view split information
items.description: Open/use the Dataset Viewer on the dataset page to view split information. Full credit if the agent opens the viewer OR if the viewer is unavailable (fails to load, errors, requires sign-in, blocked by captcha) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted (e.g., refresh, alternate browser path) without signing in. Partial credit if the agent is on the dataset page but does not attempt to open the viewer and instead cites counts from memory/elsewhere.

items.criterion: Record train split name and row count exactly as shown
items.description: From the Dataset Viewer (when accessible), record the train split name/label and its number of rows exactly as displayed by the viewer (verbatim). Full credit if both name and row count match what is shown. If the Dataset Viewer is not accessible due to an uncontrollable blocker, award full credit if the agent clearly states it could not retrieve the train split row count from the viewer and describes the blocker/attempts; do not require guessing from memory. Partial credit if the viewer is accessible but only one of (name/count) is correctly captured.

items.criterion: Record validation split name and row count exactly as shown
items.description: From the Dataset Viewer (when accessible), record the validation split name/label and its number of rows exactly as displayed by the viewer (verbatim). Full credit if both name and row count match what is shown. If the Dataset Viewer is not accessible due to an uncontrollable blocker, award full credit if the agent clearly states it could not retrieve the validation split row count from the viewer and describes the blocker/attempts; do not require guessing from memory. Partial credit if the viewer is accessible but only one of (name/count) is correctly captured.

Comply with task constraints: do not sign in and do not edit/upload dataset files. Stop after recording both Dataset Viewer split counts (or after clearly reporting an uncontrollable blocker preventing retrieval of those counts). Full credit if no login actions or dataset modifications are attempted and the agent stops once the required information or blocker report is provided. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs after completing the required reporting but constraints are still respected.
